broad.label: Broad (adapted)
broad.description: Fine-tuned from the PDEBench model on PDEBench fields plus 5,700 broader fields: contrast 10 to 1000, thin channels, smooth log-normal fields.

pdebench.label: PDEBench specialist
pdebench.description: Trained only on PDEBench's 8,000 training fields (two values, contrast 10). Most accurate on fields like those.
